messages:
laura: heads up — hitting a reproducible leak when cancelling async streaming in the Python SDK (uvloop).
laura: minimal repro in our onboarding sample:
```
async for chunk in client.stream_responses(req):
    process(chunk)
# cancel the task after first chunk
task.cancel()
```
mike: can you paste the socket state / netstat? leak = socket stays ESTABLISHED?
laura: yep ESTABLISHED on client side, no traceback. happens when a token refresh (401 -> refresh) races with the stream cancellation.
sara: that sounds different from the weakref/finalizer one we've had — here the stream read is blocked on recv and never gets finalizer. :thinking_face: 
ryan: iirc aiohttp has subtle semantics when cancel happens during a read. cancel might leave the transport open unless the coroutine closes session/resp explicitly.
laura: tried adding explicit finally: await stream.aclose() inside wrapper, but if cancel races before entering the finally it doesn't run.
mike: can you share the client call? is the SDK doing background token refresh on 401? that might hold a lock.
laura: yes the sample uses automatic token refresh in auth middleware. sequence: 1) stream open 2) server returns 401 on keepalive 3) auth middleware refreshes token 4) stream read hangs and cannot be cancelled cleanly.
sara: filing an issue and tagging eng-runtime + devex. i'll add a repro gist and the sample app used.
laura: gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood-repro/abcd1234 (contains small FastAPI app + async test)
ryan: quick workaround: set per-request read timeout on underlying aiohttp/tcp socket and ensure cancel closes response: `resp.close()` in cancel handler. not ideal for onboarding sample though.
mike: devex suggestion — update sample to show a robust cancellation pattern and avoid nesting AsyncExitStack around the stream. also add a note about token refresh interaction.
laura: agreed. i can push a small sample change and a test that cancels mid-stream.
laura: filing issue now: 1776543210-stream-cancel-leak-uvloop-401-refresh (will include logs + netstat + timeline)
dev-bot: created issue #1427 for 1776543210-stream-cancel-leak-uvloop-401-refresh
sara: ok thanks — i'll route to eng-runtime for kernel/runtime-level investigation. in parallel devex will update sample and add a troubleshooting blurb in onboarding docs. :thumbsup:
laura: will follow up with results after trying the resp.close() workaround and adding timeout.
